sections.title: How the population has changed in Bassetlaw
sections.label: Select another local authority

sections.content: In 2024, Bassetlaw was the 13th largest local authority in the East Midlands, with a population of just over 120,000. Its population increased by 1.9% compared with 2023, and has increased by 15.9% since 2001.

sections.title: Largest local authorities in the East Midlands, 2001-2024
Population density in Bassetlaw
sections.content: In 2024, the population density in Bassetlaw was 196 people per square kilometre, which was less than the East Midlands (324), and less than the United Kingdom as a whole (285).

sections.title: Densest local authorities in the East Midlands, 2024
Median age in Bassetlaw
sections.content: In 2024, the median age in Bassetlaw was 44 years, which was older than the East Midlands (41 years), and older than the United Kingdom as a whole (40 years).
